chapter: Washington, New Orleans and the road
title: Going to Louisiana: the Dew Drop Inn and meeting Fats Domino
summary: He worked a gambling club and the Dew Drop Inn in New Orleans, where lines formed and he met Fats Domino.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I'd never been to Louisiana before in my life. I'd heard about it but I never been down there. 'S'where all the Creoles is. Say, "What's Creole?"
I say, "I don't know. What is a Creole?"
Say, "Half-white women. Half-white folks. Half an' half. Creole. They call theyself Creoles. They don't like no black people."
"Well, I don't think I like that."
Say, "Well, we goin'. We got a job down there."
So I call my wife up, 'tol her I was goin' t'Louisiana. I got down...

She say, "Well, I meet you down there."
I say, "Well, wait till I get there first...see what it's all about."

She say, "All right. You call me when you get to Louisiana."
I went to Louisiana, went to a nightclub called the Dew Drop Inn. First I worked in another nightclub. I don't remember the name of it. It was upstairs where they had a lot of gamblin'. Gamblin' was wide open...an' ever'thin' you want to...play dice, play cards...all kin' o' different...turn wheels 'n' stuff like that. 'Cept well I had seen that in Kansas City but I never seen it as big as that.

So I took all that in. I looked 'em over. So we started workin' at the Dew Drop Inn. My wife came down there and brought the dog. So then, I worked at the Dew Drop...we worked at the Dew Drop Inn. They had a line standin' out around the corner...come see Big Joe Turner an' Pete Johnson...blues singers. 'S'at's where I met Fats Domino an' uh, we playin' in the nightclub...Fats Domino would come out to the bar. Had two...had three bars in the place--one outside in the lobby when you open the door you come in...have one in the bar an' had another one on the other side of the place. People be stacked in there on top o' one another.
